$comment: What this repo takes from the web app, and how strictly it is held.
pinned  - must be byte-identical to upstream. These are the files whose
value is their tuned constants, not their shape: the engine, the
presets, the visualizer, the storage migration. Divergence here
is a bug even when it compiles, so CI fails on it.
forked  - deliberately different on Android. The upstream hash is still
recorded, so 'upstream has moved on' remains answerable, but
local edits are expected and do not fail the check.
src/app/apple-icon.tsx is absent on purpose. It is a dynamic route that
rasterises through Satori at request time, which a static export cannot do.
WHY ModeDot.tsx AND CommandCenter.tsx ARE FORKED
Both were pinned until the touch layer landed. Both hardcode keyboard
copy: ModeDot's hint sequence is 'To pause, press P' / 'Want it
seamless?' / 'Press Shift + C', and CommandCenter is a list of ten key
chords. On a device with no keyboard every one of those lines names a
thing the user cannot do, which is worse than saying nothing.
Forking them costs nothing that pinning was protecting. The point of a
pin is a constant arrived at by ear that no reader could re-derive.
Neither file contains one; their content is words. The audio engine, the
presets and the visualizer remain pinned, which is where the value is.
Both edits are additive and defaulted -- an optional `steps` prop and an
optional `touch` flag -- so a desktop browser gets exactly what it got
before, and the diff against upstream stays small enough to re-apply by
hand when the web app moves on.
